# History markers (ADR 0308, Gap R.190).
#
# One pattern per line (case-insensitive substring, not a regex). A line that carries any of
# these is reporting the PAST — the retired engine, a measurement taken while it ran, or the
# retirement itself — and is therefore allowed to name an engine that no longer runs. That is the
# whole difference between a stale claim and a measurement: "both engines printed `1` before ADR
# 0297" is evidence, and deleting it would delete the record of a bug this project found with two
# implementations and cannot find with one.
#
# Keep this list narrow. Every entry is a licence to say "both engines"; adding to it is adding a
# way to avoid the guard.
\bused\ to\b
\bused\ to\ be\b
\buntil\b
\bbefore\b
\bafter\b
\bwhile\ the\b
\bsince\b
\bretir\b
\bno\ longer\b
